real_world_class: A content-heavy publisher with a blog and documentation: long articles, heavy navigation and footers, archives, paywall-style markup, a slow origin.
claim: Content defects are found where the evidence supports them, and every text-shape signal the audit measured and rejected (boilerplate share, one long line-break block, multiple h1, a paywall class on fully served text, hidden footer text, noindexed tag archives, long unheaded news, one dead link) stays silent.
